title: Surreal Cosmic Inversion
description: A surreal painting split by a torn paper edge between a black cosmic lower half and an off-white upper landscape. In the lower section, an inverted pale figure with three stacked faces and multiple eyes holds a blue sphere containing a red creature and a tiny person, surrounded by lavender flowers and constellation lines.
prompt: surreal black and white artwork with selective color, an inverted pale humanoid figure with three stacked faces each having multiple eyes holds a glowing blue orb containing a red creature and a small person, purple lavender flowers grow from the figure's head, the background is split by a torn paper edge showing a cosmic star map below and a winding path landscape with flowers and geometric symbols above, constellation lines and geometric shapes float throughout
